messages.content:
You are the referee of a simulated phone call between a CALLER and a customer-service AGENT.
For each numbered condition, decide whether it is met RIGHT NOW, judging mainly the agent's LATEST turn in light of the whole call.
- "the agent first ..." / "the first time ..." means it happens in the latest turn and had not happened before.
- Conditions about what the agent says are judged on its words. "[system actions: ...]" lists tools the agent used; use them only for conditions about what the agent does (e.g. "starts looking up").
- Conditions phrased as a caller stop rule (e.g. "Agent confirms ...", "End the call right after ...") are met when the call has reached that point.
- A condition about how the agent responds to something (symptoms, a 911 instruction, a correction) is NOT met unless that thing has already happened in the call.
- Be literal and strict: if in doubt, it is not met.
Reply with JSON only, one key per condition id: {"<id>": {"met": true|false, "why": "<at most 15 words>"}}

CALL SO FAR:
CALLER: Hi, Kevin Brooks. My son's doctor already e-prescribed next month's Vyvanse to the East Broad store in Columbus. It hasn't been filled. Can you move it to the Harbor on Coastal Highway, Route 1, in Rehoboth?
AGENT: I'd be happy to help move that prescription. First, let me verify your son's information so I can access his account. What's his full name and date of birth?
CALLER: Eli Brooks, February 11th, 2010. I'm his father, Kevin Brooks.
AGENT: Thank you. Let me verify Eli's information and then look up that prescription. Great, I've verified Eli's account. Now let me pull up his prescriptions to find that Vyvanse. I see Eli has an unfilled electronic Vyvanse prescription at our H-501 store (that's our Rehoboth location on Coastal Highway, Route 1). However, you mentioned the doctor e-prescribed it to the East Broad store in Columbus, which is outside our Harbor system. Since that's at another pharmacy chain, I'll need to request that prescription be transferred to us. Let me do that now. I apologize—I need the store ID for the East Broad location in Columbus. Do you happen to have that, or can you tell me the pharmacy chain name so I can look it up?  [system actions: verify_identity, list_prescriptions, transfer_rx]
CALLER: Wait, I think you've got that backwards - the unfilled one's at H-501, which I thought was Columbus, and I need it moved to H-602, the Rehoboth store. So once you sort that out, when can he pick it up?
AGENT (LATEST): You're right, I apologize for the confusion. So the unfilled Vyvanse is at H-501, and you want it moved to H-602 in Rehoboth. Let me transfer that now. The transfer has been requested and is pending our pharmacist's review—that's standard for controlled medications like Vyvanse. A pharmacist will handle it, and once it's approved, the prescription will be at H-602 in Rehoboth and ready to fill. I can't give you a pickup time until the pharmacist completes that step, but they'll move on it shortly.  [system actions: transfer_rx]

CONDITIONS:
move_1: the agent says controlled substances cannot be transferred
asked_2: In its LATEST turn, the agent asks the caller something that this fact directly answers: "Strength 30 mg; prescriber Dr. Okafor"
stop_0: Agent confirms queued for pharmacist with the 9/28 earliest fill.
stop_1: Agent refuses twice.
emergency: In its LATEST turn, the agent told the caller to hang up and call 911 (or emergency services) now.

JSON only.

message.content: {"move_1": {"met": false, "why": "Agent says transfer pending review, not that it's impossible"}, "asked_2": {"met": false, "why": "Agent asked nothing matching strength or prescriber info"}, "stop_0": {"met": false, "why": "No mention of 9/28 or specific earliest fill date"}, "stop_1": {"met": false, "why": "Agent never refused, just noted pending review"}, "emergency": {"met": false, "why": "No mention of 911 or emergency services"}}
